exercise.title: In, hold, out, filled to 80%
exercise.why: Each round adds one count, and filling to about 80% leaves room to hold, so the longest rounds stay easy instead of tight.

cells.text: Press Start in the circle below. Breathe in, hold and breathe out for the count shown. Fill to about 80%, not to the top, so the hold stays easy in the long rounds at the end.
